schemas.description: 进入规划模式。切换后写操作会在执行层被拦截（写计划文件除外），你只保有只读能力。适合：新功能实现、多文件改动、架构决策、需求不明确的任务。不适合：单行修复、明确的指令、纯探索任务。进入后按流程操作：探索 → 设计 → 写计划文件 → exit_plan_mode 提交审批。
schemas.name: enter_plan_mode

schemas.description: 提交计划给用户审批。调用前必须先写好计划文件。如果计划包含多个方案，用 options 参数列出（2-3个），用户会选择一个。用户可以：批准 / 修改（带反馈，留在规划模式）/ 拒绝。批准后自动切换到执行模式，所有工具恢复可用。
schemas.name: exit_plan_mode

options.description: 可选：2-3个备选方案，用户审批时选择一个。每个方案有 label 和 description。

schemas.description: 查看上下文压缩的运行状态和数据。包括：已记录的压缩次数、压缩比、信息丢失估计、自动调优状态、当前参数 vs 推荐参数。用户问"压缩调得怎么样"或"压缩数据够不够"时调用。
schemas.name: hologram_compaction_stats

schemas.description: Sub-agent and inter-agent coordination: spawn / status / kill / message / request / reply / inbox / ack / list / merge / discover / lookup / isolation.
schemas.name: agent

agent_id.description: The sub-agent ID to kill (returned by agent_spawn with async=true)

agent_ids.description: Sub-agent IDs to merge. If omitted, merges all completed sub-agents.

async.description: If true, returns immediately with the sub-agent ID. The sub-agent runs in the background; its result arrives via agent_message (type: "result"). If false (default), blocks until the sub-agent finishes. Use agent_merge to merge completed async sub-agents.

category.description: Category: "architecture" / "bug" / "pattern" / "config" / "other" (action: discover); Filter by category (optional): "architecture" / "bug" / "pattern" / "config" / "other" (action: lookup)

content.description: Message content (action: message); Request content — what you want the other agent to do or answer (action: request); Reply content (action: reply)

description.description: Short label for the sub-agent task (3-5 words, used in progress display)

key.description: Short label for this discovery (e.g. "auth-location", "config-entry-point") (action: discover); Filter by discovery key (optional, partial match) (action: lookup)

limit.description: Max messages to return (newest first). Default: all. (action: inbox); Max number of results (default 20) (action: lookup)

message_id.description: ID of the message to reply to (from inbox notification) (action: reply); Read a specific message by ID. Returns full content. (action: inbox); ID of the message to acknowledge (action: ack)

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema (object-rooted) the sub-agent result must satisfy. Supported keywords: type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf. Only valid in blocking mode (async=false). The validated JSON object is returned as the tool result.

prompt.description: Complete, self-contained task directive for the sub-agent. Must include: what to do, which files to modify, and the expected outcome. Do NOT instruct the sub-agent to run builds or tests — it cannot do so (parallel build tools cause file-lock deadlocks). Verification is the parent agent's responsibility after all sub-agents finish. When spawning multiple sub-agents in parallel, give each a distinct, non-overlapping set of files to avoid write conflicts.

reason.description: Optional reason for killing the agent (for logging)

since.description: Only return discoveries with ts >= since (Unix ms, optional)

subagent_type.description: Omit to fork (inherits your recent context — DEFAULT). Set to "fresh" for a clean-slate sub-agent.

target.description: Target agent ID (action: message); Target agent ID to send the request to (action: request)

timeout_minutes.description: Optional timeout override (default 30 minutes). The sub-agent is aborted when it exceeds this.

tool_allowlist.description: Optional list of tool names the sub-agent is allowed to use. If omitted, all tools are available. Example: ["read_file", "search_content", "inspect_symbol"] for a read-only research agent.

type.description: Message type (e.g. "question", "status", "handoff") (action: message); Request type (e.g. "question", "lookup", "verify") (action: request); Filter by message type (e.g. "request", "status", "handoff"). (action: inbox)

value.description: The discovery content — be specific (file paths, line numbers, findings)

worktree.description: "keep" (default) — leave the worktree intact for manual merge. "discard" — clean up the worktree.

schemas.description: Task board: create / get / list / update / stop / board.
schemas.name: task

detail.description: What needs to be done, in one sentence (action: create); Updated detail text (optional) (action: update)

id.description: Task ID to fetch (action: get); Task ID to update (action: update); Task ID to stop (action: stop)

status.description: Optional status filter. Omit to list all. (action: list); New status for the task (action: update)

title.description: Short task title (3-8 words) (action: create); New title (optional) (action: update)
